description: This Java source file defines the PostgreSQLUuidType class, which extends CharType to customize the data type mapping for UUIDs in PostgreSQL databases, specifically converting UUIDs to CHAR(36).

classes.name: PostgreSQLUuidType
classes.description: A custom data type class extending CharType to handle UUID conversions specifically for PostgreSQL databases, converting UUIDs in certain cases to CHAR(36).

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Overrides the method to convert UUIDs to CHAR(36) for PostgreSQL databases when the size is 38; otherwise delegates to the superclass.

methods.description: Overrides the method to increase the priority of this data type slightly above the default.
